simple.meaning: טָהוֹר (ṭâhôwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 94 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 7:2. Its contexts include offering, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טָהוֹר (H2889).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
